actualscope: Read both complete target manuscripts and target diagram JSON files first, without source text or other reviews.

Compared complete prose, headings, bold summary, table headers and every table cell, translated title/description metadata, diagram alt text and every diagram label against the complete English source and its English diagram content.

Checked conditions, negatives, uncertainties, licensing and proprietary-game distinctions, development hosts versus export targets, source-available versus open-source distinction, proposed evaluation versus locally executed Godot-only evidence, finite/nonnegative input assumptions, version/date/numeric units, and test limitations.
Mechanically compared all four fenced blocks including language markers and contents, external Markdown link URL sequences and inline-code sequences against English: identical for both languages.

Checked structured diagram JSON validity, stable key, locale, step count, kinds and ordered operation correspondence. The diagram describes one advance call; repeated tests remain in the manuscript harness.

Checked staging metadata language, translationKey, sourcePath and sourceSha256. The source hash matches the read English file. Draft metadata differs from publication metadata by design; publication-field propagation is outside this translation review.
assessment: No material meaning, omission, protected-token, or language-consistency issues identified in the reviewed versions.
limits: AI review only; no human or native-speaker review claimed and no guarantee of exhaustive error detection.
Did not execute Godot or other engines, recheck release/license/platform sources online, or independently validate factual claims of the English source.
Did not build the site, render SVGs or browse the published pages. Relative staging SVG references were assessed as staging references, not verified production assets.
Read no author verdicts or other reviewers findings. Target files remained read-only.
